headline: Football watchdog chair asserts 'absolute' power to force City sale
description: The Independent Football Regulator will have "absolute power" to force Manchester City's owners to sell if they are ultimately found to have run the club improperly, the watchdog's chair has said.

headline: Michael Carrick: I feel backing of Man United board but need to win games
description: Michael Carrick has said he feels the backing of the Manchester United board -- but admits it will only continue if he starts winning games.

headline: Referees' boss Webb backs VAR over Newcastle's Botman challenge on Villa's Jackson
description: Referees boss Howard Webb believes the video assistant referee was right not to intervene after Newcastle's Sven Botman was shown a yellow card for his tackle on Aston Villa's Nicolas Jackson at the weekend.
